Chapter 494 - 494 Declare; Completion Of The Third Problem!

Chapter 494 - 494 Declare; Completion of the Third Problem!

494 Declare; Completion of the Third Problem!

Not long ago, Feng Zhixiang had already met Hu Shaodong.

He saw with his own eyes… Hu Shaodong, who had put on the advanced version of prosthetic limbs, was so powerful that it was not an exaggeration to call him Superman!

It would not be long before the team of disabled soldiers could all be equipped with prosthetic limbs and become a team of superhuman soldiers.

How could this not make Feng Zhixiang happy?

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “I’ve already promised you this. You don’t have to be so polite.

“Oh, right, did you just say controllable nuclear fusion?”

Feng Zhixiang smiled and said, “I was just making an analogy… I used to hear academicians say that if controllable nuclear fusion is developed, new energy vehicles can last thousands of kilometers.

“Now, with your super battery, I don’t think there’s a need to rush into controllable nuclear fusion.”

What he said was to highlight the importance of Lin Fan’s super battery.

It was a disguised form of praise for Lin Fan.

Generally speaking, people liked to be praised.

Feng Zhixiang believed that Lin Fan would be in a good mood after hearing this.

However, Lin Fan shook his head and said, “We still have to study controllable nuclear fusion. Maybe there’ll be results soon.”

After all, as long as he completed the mission, he could master controllable nuclear fusion technology.

He was just foreshadowing in advance.

“What’s so great about controllable nuclear fusion?” Feng Zhixiang asked. “It’s just a little more energy, but if an accident were to happen, it would be a terrible disaster.

“Your super battery is the best. It’s safe, reliable, stable, and lasts for a long time!”

Another praise.

Feng Zhixiang felt that Lin Fan would definitely be very happy. His relationship with Lin Fan had taken another big step closer.

Lin Fan glanced at Feng Zhixiang and said, “I’m preparing to research controllable nuclear fusion.”

“Huh?”

Feng Zhixiang was slightly stunned.

He had just praised the super battery and belittled the controllable nuclear fusion…

Now, Lin Fan wanted to research controllable nuclear fusion?

Did he dig a hole for himself?

Feng Zhixiang could not help but cough dryly and said, “So, you want to research controllable nuclear fusion…

“This is good! Controlled nuclear fusion has a small size, high energy, and increased cleanliness. Once the research is successful, it can directly replace our thermal power generation and completely free up our productivity…”

Once he opened his mouth, Feng Zhixiang could not stop.

He kept talking about the advantages of controllable nuclear fusion.

It was as if he was not the one who was belittling controllable nuclear fusion just now.

Lin Fan could not help but look at Feng Zhixiang. He had a strange expression on his face and said, “So, Director Feng, can you help me apply for the controllable nuclear fusion research and development qualification?”

Any nuclear research was definitely not something that an individual could casually carry out.

Especially since Lin Fan wanted to set up a factory, he needed the approval of the country.

Feng Zhixiang was slightly stunned.

After a while, he said, “Professor Lin, you want the controllable nuclear fusion factory qualification?”

Generally speaking, controllable nuclear fusion research only needed to be done in a laboratory.

Factory qualifications?

Was this not only needed for mass production after the research was successful?

Lin Fan naturally understood Feng Zhixiang’s doubts, but he did not explain too much and continued, “Yes, and I need to build a controllable nuclear fusion plant that covers an area of more than 10,000 acres.”

Feng Zhixiang was stunned again.

10,000 acres of controllable nuclear fusion?

This was definitely a large factory.

Hua Nation did not even have such a large controllable nuclear fusion plant.

So big?

“Can’t I?” Lin Fan said.

Only then did Feng Zhixiang come back to his senses and said, “If it were anyone else, it definitely wouldn’t work!”

He was absolutely not spouting nonsense.

Nuclear power was too dangerous for the country and even the entire world.

If the country let just anyone study it, it would definitely be a terrifying thing.

He paused for a moment before continuing, “But as for you… I’ll report this matter to the higher-ups. As for whether it’ll work out or not, it’s up to the higher-ups to decide.”

Lin Fan said, “When can we get the news?”

“I’ll make a trip to the capital later. If everything goes well… about two days,” Feng Zhixiang said.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright.”

Feng Zhixiang hesitated. “Professor Lin, actually, if you want to research controllable nuclear fusion, I can help you apply for the project. You’ll be the chief engineer and the person in charge. When the time comes, the factory, equipment, and everything will be ready for you…”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “That’s not necessary. I’ll do my own research.”

After all, this mission required him to build a controllable nuclear fusion plant of more than 10,000 acres.

If the country helped, how could the mission be completed?

Seeing Lin Fan’s insistence, Feng Zhixiang did not say anything else. He said helplessly, “Alright then.”

Then, Feng Zhixiang chatted for a while before leaving slowly.

Lin Fan lay on the sofa and continued to play with his phone.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Lin Fan spent 3,680 yuan and ate breakfast from a two-star Michelin restaurant before heading to Jiangbei University.

At this time, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian were already reading quietly in the office.

Only Hao Zhiwu’s seat was still empty.

Just as Lin Fan was about to sit down in the executive chair to rest…

At this moment, footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

Hao Zhiwu slowly walked in with a tired body and a weak expression.

This weekend, he was completely immersed in the gaming helmet.

Even though one was meant to play with the gaming helmet by lying on the bed with one’s eyes closed, the brain would always be thinking. Thus, one would also be tired.

“Good morning, Professor Lin.” Hao Zhiwu yawned.

When Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian heard this, they raised their heads and greeted, “Good morning, Professor Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded at everyone and said, “Good morning.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue quickly took out a bottle of energy drinks from their drawers and handed them to Lin Fan.

When they saw Lin Fan drink a mouthful of each bottle, a sweet smile appeared on their faces.

However, they did not behave like usual. They immediately returned to their seats and continued to read quietly with their heads lowered.

Today, Xia Bing and Xia Xue looked like they wanted to say something but hesitated.

Liu Qianqian, who was sitting beside her, could not help but say,” Xia Bing and Xia Xue have solved the third question.”

“Oh?”

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but look at Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s computers.

Sure enough, their computers had turned into normal desktop displays.

This meant that their third problem had been solved!

Lin Fan said happily, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, you guys did well!”

After all, his students had to win international awards.

Only then would he be able to complete the system mission.

After solving all three problems, they were undoubtedly one step closer to winning an international award.
